title: External Sources
description: Schema for external-sources.json (#3039): every external project, skill, command or idea IDPF has copied, adapted, been inspired by, or compared itself against, with its license. Dev-only — listed in framework-manifest.json excludedFromDeployment. Read by tests/reference/external-sources.test.js, which keeps THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md in step with it and enforces the license allowlist for copied and adapted entries, and by the dev-only external-source-attributed review criterion.

id.description: Stable kebab-case key. An "External source" field in an issue body may name this or the url.

name.description: Display name. Must match one `## <name>` heading in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md exactly.

pinned.description: Commit SHA or version that was taken or compared.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (MIT, Apache-2.0, CC-BY-4.0, LicenseRef-…), or NOASSERTION when unknown. The schema checks shape only; the redistribution allowlist for copied and adapted entries is enforced by the guard test.

copyright.description: Holder line, verbatim from the source's license file.

relationship.description: copied and adapted carry a license obligation (notice reproduced in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md); inspired-by is credit given by choice; compared records an analysis where nothing was taken.

taken.description: One line: what was taken, or "nothing" for compared.

landedIn.description: Repo-relative paths where the taken material or analysis lives.
